title: LLM 架构聊天截图
author: Zaid
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,应用 / 网页设计,极简主义,图解 / 图表,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot of an AI chat interface showing a generated technical infographic about how Large Language Models (LLMs) work technically. The screenshot should look like a modern web app conversation, not a standalone poster.

Canvas: 768×1024 vertical screenshot, light gray app background, rounded white content areas, clean sans-serif typography, subtle shadows, high-resolution but with the infographic text slightly small like a real embedded generated image.

Chat UI layout: At the top left show a small circular user avatar, the chat title “Visualizing LLM Architecture” with a tiny dropdown chevron, and at the top right a simple “Files” label with an icon. Below, show a rounded user message bubble aligned near the top center/right containing: “make an image explaining how LLMs work technically”. Under it, show a small status row reading “Scira task complete” with a sparkle/loader icon and chevron. The main generated image appears below as a large rounded rectangle card. Beneath the image, include assistant explanatory text: “The image above is a comprehensive technical infographic breaking down how Large Language Models function under the hood. Here is a detailed walkthrough of each component shown:” followed by the bold section heading “Tokenization: From Text to Numbers”. At the bottom, show a rounded input box with placeholder “Ask a follow-up...”, a plus button on the left, small tool/model controls on the right, the model label “Kimi K2.6” with a dropdown, and a circular voice button.

Generated infographic inside the chat: Design a blue-and-white technical educational poster titled in large navy caps: “HOW LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS (LLMs) WORK”. Use a white background, navy-blue outlines, light-blue highlights, rounded panels, arrows connecting steps, miniature charts, equations, tables, and icons. The poster should be information-dense and engineering-oriented.

Infographic sections: Use exactly 8 labeled panels/areas:
1. “INPUT: TOKENIZATION” panel showing a raw text box with the sentence “The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.”, a tokenizer block, token boxes for the words, and token ID boxes.
2. “EMBEDDINGS” panel showing token IDs converted into dense vectors, with a small table of numeric embedding values.
3. “TRANSFORMER ARCHITECTURE” panel showing a stacked transformer block with Add & Norm, Feed-Forward Network, Multi-Head Self-Attention, input embeddings, positional encoding, and layer repetition notation.
4A. “SELF-ATTENTION MECHANISM (INSIDE ONE HEAD)” wide lower-left panel showing matrices for input embeddings, queries, keys, values, attention scores, softmax, attention weights, weighted sum, and equations.
4B. “ATTENTION: TOKENS ATTEND TO EACH OTHER” panel showing a network graph of tokens from the example sentence connected by blue lines plus attention-weight bars.
5. “OUTPUT: NEXT TOKEN PREDICTION” panel showing probability distribution bars for candidate next tokens such as cat, sat, on, the, mat, roof, then highlighting the predicted next token “the”.
6. “TRAINING: PRE-TRAINING WITH NEXT-TOKEN PREDICTION” long bottom strip divided into 5 mini-cards: massive text corpus, creating training examples, model prediction, loss calculation, and backpropagation/update.
7. Bottom process arrow reading “Repeat for billions of examples over many epochs until convergence.”
8. Bottom-right result callout with a brain icon explaining that the model learns general language patterns and knowledge.

Visual style: Crisp vector infographic, academic but friendly, dark navy headings, medium-blue borders, pale-blue fills, tiny tables and plots, clean arrows, rounded cards, consistent spacing. Make the embedded infographic resemble an AI-generated educational diagram with dense but mostly legible small text.

Constraints: Keep all UI text in English. Do not add watermarks. Preserve the visible chat screenshot framing and the large embedded infographic. Use exactly the listed 8 infographic areas and exactly 5 mini-cards inside the training strip.\

title: 天津市宣传海报提示

categories: 海报 / 传单,插画,水墨 / 中国风,城市景观 / 街景,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
A 2026 Tianjin city promotional poster filled with a festive Spring Festival atmosphere, while combining elegant style and urban cultural heritage.
The overall image uses a 'Guochao' (national tide) illustration + double exposure artistic technique. The composition continues an S-shaped flow, with natural and smooth visual guidance, combining modern design sense with Eastern aesthetic charm.

On a pure white high-grade textured background, the image maintains large areas of white space, making the overall feel fresh, elegant, and transparent.
In the bottom right corner stands a miniature figure in traditional Chinese clothing, with a dynamic posture, waving a long red silk dance ribbon.
This red silk has a soft, elegant, and tense texture, spiraling upward in the air and naturally extending to the top left, forming a highly visually impactful flow trajectory.

As the red silk extends, it gradually transforms into a magnificent Haihe River water vein, while integrating the cultural context and geographical imagery of Tianjin, like an urban scroll connecting the past and present.
In the visual subject formed by the intersection of this 'river' and the silk, a hand-drawn panoramic map of Tianjin city is overlaid, in Guochao style, with rich layers, magnificent momentum, and exquisite, shocking details.

Key landmarks and urban elements of Tianjin are highlighted in the frame:
Tianjin Eye (prominent landmark, highly recognizable)
Haihe River (core water system running through the frame)
Jiefang Bridge (embodying urban history and industrial beauty)
Jinwan Plaza architectural complex (showing modern urban prosperity)
Century Clock (iconic landscape)
Ancient Culture Street (embodying traditional culture)
Five Great Avenues villa complex (embodying the historical style of blending East and West)
Drum Tower (embodying Tianjin's ancient charm)
Italian Style District (adding urban romance and exotic flavor)
Tianjin Port and ocean freighter elements (embodying the city's character of openness, port, and global connectivity)
Appropriately integrate cultural symbols like Yangliuqing New Year paintings, Niren Zhang clay sculptures, crosstalk culture symbols, and fried dough twists (Mahua) as decorative details to enhance regional identity.

The entire image presents a visual mood of 'river, city, bridge, port, and the fusion of past and present,' with light clouds and misty water vapor, carrying the ethereal feel of Eastern aesthetics.
Colors are mainly Chinese red, gold, elegant white, green, and light blue, with warm gold accents in some areas; the overall feel is festive but not vulgar, rich but not cluttered.

Image Requirements:
Rich details, complex structure, clear layers.
The city landscape is fully visible, providing a sense of shock and artistry.
Maintain a Spring Festival atmosphere, modern aesthetics, and promotional poster quality.
Obvious hand-drawn feel, exquisite and beautiful, with collectible visual quality.
Has both the momentum of a city promotional film poster and the high-end feel of tourism posters.

Text Layout Requirements:
Elegant typography in the bottom left for the English title: 'SPRING 2026'.
Accompanied by vertical Chinese promotional slogans, such as:
'River and Sea Jinmen, Charming Tianjin'
or
'Jinmen Hometown, Open Tianjin'
or
'Ancient and Modern Fusion, Myriad Tianjin'.

Text Requirements:
Beautiful and generous layout.
Clear and complete handwriting.
High-end poster design sense.
Harmonious combination of Chinese and English.
No garbled characters, no typos.

Overall Meaning:
Showcase the unique charm of Tianjin as a famous historical and cultural city, an important northern port city, and a modern international metropolis, reflecting the charm of the Haihe River, the ancient charm of Jinmen, and the open and inclusive urban spirit.

Poster Size: 9:16 vertical.\

title: 汉服琵琶花园肖像
author: 小小东
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,角色,建筑 / 室内
prompt_en: Create a collectible fine-art realistic photograph inspired by classical Chinese garden aesthetics: a young Hanfu musician seated in a quiet scholar garden, holding a pear-shaped pipa vertically in front of her body as if mid-performance. She wears layered traditional robes with a white inner garment, pale aqua translucent shawl sleeves, and a black embroidered skirt with small floral patterns; her hair is styled in an ornate classical updo with delicate pink-and-white flower hairpins. Her face is softly obscured with a natural beige blur, keeping the focus on posture, costume, and instrument. The setting is a minimalist white plaster garden wall with a flowering tree branch entering from the upper left, covered in tiny white blossoms and fresh green leaves, and a large grey Taihu scholar rock formation on the right and lower foreground with sparse ornamental grass at its base. Add vertical black Chinese brush calligraphy on the upper right wall, with two small red seal stamps beneath it, reading like an elegant inscription rather than a modern caption. Use soft diffused daylight, muted pastel tones, shallow depth of field, delicate shadows, and museum-quality editorial photography composition. The pipa should have visible frets, wooden tuning pegs, pale polished wood grain, and be centered over the figure’s torso. Overall mood: serene, poetic, refined, timeless, as if photographed by a top-tier art photographer in a real classical garden. Customize the subject as an anonymous Hanfu pipa musician, the costume palette as white, pale aqua, and black floral embroidery, the instrument as Chinese pipa, the wall inscription as vertical classical Chinese brush calligraphy with red seals, and the setting as white wall, blossoming branch, and Taihu scholar rocks.\

prompt_en: A realistic documentary-style photo of the entrance area inside Jing'an Temple Station on Line 2 in Shanghai Metro, viewed from a passenger's eye level while walking toward the fare gates. The scene is a wide indoor station concourse with a modern ceiling made of dark brown curved wooden slats and long linear white lights. In the center hangs a large dark overhead wayfinding sign with a green square route marker showing the number 2 and the text “2号线 / Line 2,” the main station name “静安寺站 / Jing'an Temple Station,” and a service center icon with the bilingual text “服务中心 / Service Center.” Below the sign are multiple stainless steel fare gates, with exactly 6 visible gate lanes in the foreground, some showing green arrow indicators and at least one showing a red no-entry symbol. Show a busy but orderly flow of commuters, around 10 to 15 adults in everyday autumn clothing, seen mostly from behind, walking into the station through the gates; include jackets, jeans, backpacks, shoulder bags, and neutral colors. On the left wall, include ticket or vending machines and another smaller green Line 2 sign. On the right wall, create a decorative white station wall with large black Chinese calligraphy reading “静安寺” and subtle wave-like graphic lines, plus a small green Line 2 marker nearby. Materials should feel authentic: polished gray speckled stone floor, metallic columns, tiled walls, and realistic transit fixtures. Lighting is bright, even, and fluorescent, with a clean public-transport atmosphere. Compose it as a slightly wide-angle smartphone photo, centered on the overhead sign and gate area, highly realistic, candid, detailed, and true to an actual Shanghai metro station interior.\

title: 数字拼图应用程序图标概念
author: きくらげ@個人開発
categories: 应用 / 网页设计,产品营销,3D 渲染,极简主义,等距视角,抽象 / 背景,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a polished presentation board of number-play and logic puzzle app icon concepts, showing multiple alternative icon directions for a modern mobile app.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape canvas on a warm off-white background, minimal gallery-style spacing, soft shadows, premium design-review mockup aesthetic.

Header: Centered at the top, large elegant serif title text: App Icon Concepts. Under it, a small uppercase tagline with spaced letters: PLAY WITH NUMBERS • LOGIC • PATTERN • RHYTHM • CURIOSITY. Use tiny colored dots between the words.

Layout: Arrange exactly 10 rounded-square app icons in a clean 2-row by 5-column grid. Each icon is the same size with consistent corner radius and subtle drop shadow. Add a single centered letter label beneath each icon, exactly A through J.

Icon concepts, exactly 10:
A: Cream monochrome icon with stacked 3D numerals 1, 2, and 3 standing on a circular pedestal, sculptural clay/plaster look.
B: Dark navy icon with four raised rounded number tiles, colored blue 7, cream 3, orange 5, and teal 8, arranged like playful puzzle blocks.
C: Deep purple-black icon with a large gradient numeral 9 in orange-to-magenta-to-violet, with colorful particle dots bursting from the right edge.
D: Dark teal icon showing an orbital logic pattern: concentric circular paths, small white spheres, and a glowing cyan center.
E: Warm ivory icon with flowing rainbow wave bands rising from left to right, small Fibonacci-like numbers above the wave: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21.
F: Dark indigo icon with a geometric network made of thin white connecting lines and dots, with a glowing golden center point like a constellation.
G: Dark teal icon with a luminous infinity loop made from many fine parallel lines, transitioning from cyan on the left to golden orange on the right.
H: Light cream icon with a 3x3 grid of tactile number tiles, numbers 2 4 7 on the top row, 1 5 6 in the middle, 8 3 9 on the bottom; the 5 tile is blue and the 7 and 8 tiles are dark.
I: Dark navy icon with a large glossy white 3D question mark, small colored buttons/dots on it, suggesting curiosity and puzzles.
J: Near-black icon with a circular color wheel or dial around a dark central disk, segmented rainbow colors, plus a small white sphere at the upper right edge.

Visual style: High-end app store icon exploration sheet, soft 3D rendering mixed with clean vector precision, rounded corners, realistic highlights, subtle ambient occlusion, crisp typography, balanced white space, no watermark.

Constraints: Keep the board uncluttered, preserve exactly 10 concepts and the A–J labels, avoid adding extra icons or explanatory text beyond the title, tagline, numbers inside icons, and labels.\

In the foreground, one adult man with a blurred, indistinct face is running toward the camera between lanes, wearing a dark jacket and dark pants, his posture urgent and off-balance as if escaping danger. To his left is a dark gray sedan with headlights on, splashing through wet pavement. In the midground on the right, 2 wrecked cars are colliding: 1 silver sedan with its driver-side door open and 1 dark vehicle flipping upside down in midair, surrounded by shattered glass, torn metal, and flying debris. Count 2 visible fireballs in the background, one on the far left street and one large explosion on the right side, both sending sparks and black smoke into the sky. Show heavy smoke plumes rising above a dense downtown skyline of tall, slightly out-of-focus buildings. Include wet reflective asphalt, scattered car parts across the road, glowing streetlights, utility poles, overhead power lines, and a moody blue-gray storm atmosphere with orange firelight reflecting in puddles. Framing should be wide-angle and low to the street, with strong motion, dramatic perspective, cinematic depth of field, realistic physics, volumetric smoke, flying embers, and high-detail disaster-movie lighting. Add a white Pollo.ai watermark in the top-right corner.\

prompt_en:
Subject:
Red wall and summer profile

Person/Expression:
Woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige fair skin with a slight pinkish healthy glow and natural texture. Soft highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones, retaining delicate skin texture rather than excessive skin blurring. Precise and elegant doll-like Japanese-style makeup, pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long slender eyelashes, natural tear bags, light-brown eyebrows, and sheer pink-beige lip gloss. Small, clear catchlights in the eyes. The expression is calm, looking coolly into the distance. Dark brown hair tied in a loose low ponytail, with fine loose hairs around the face blowing in the wind.

Clothing/Pose:
Ivory thin strap ribbed knit camisole. The collarbone and shoulder lines are naturally visible, but exposure is elegantly suppressed. Bottoms are high-waisted wide pants in off-white beige, made of thin linen-blend material, with a long cloth belt of the same color tied at the waist. Feet are in brown-beige thin strap sandals. The person sits diagonally on a low terracotta-colored wall, supporting her body with her right hand on the wall, leaning her left knee slightly up, and extending her right leg naturally downward. The upper body is twisted slightly toward the left of the screen, and the face is turned toward the blue sky.

Background/Light:
A minimalist architectural space like a Japanese modern art museum or a modern rooftop terrace by the sea. Reddish-brown terracotta walls, a low parapet, a large vertical wall on the left, a thin eave above, and a clear summer blue sky stretching in the distance. The walls and floors have detailed stucco and concrete textures. Strong afternoon sunlight shines from the upper left of the screen, casting a large diagonal shadow on the left wall and the subject's shadow onto the wall surface. Warm light enters the edges of the shoulders, cheeks, and hair, while the shadow side falls deeply but is slightly lifted by the blue reflected light from the sky.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. A medium-distance fashion portrait. The person is placed toward the right side of the screen, leaving a wide margin of blue sky in the upper half. The red wall on the left and the diagonal shadow create a strong geometric composition. The full body is included, but there is a little room near the sandals at the bottom edge. The camera is at a slightly lower eye level with a slight upward angle. Focus on the face and upper body, with a natural depth of field that is not too shallow.

Texture/Style:
Realistic photo-style AI image. Japanese summer fashion editorial style, strong sunlight, dry air, and a color plane contrast between terracotta and the blue sky. Skin has a natural texture, and clothing shows the weave of linen and ribbed knit. High contrast but not too hard, with fine grain and a calm color tone like a film photograph. Avoid excessive HDR, excessive skin blurring, and anime styles.

Negative:
Faces looking too young, unnatural gazes, excessive 'wanghong' makeup, plastic-like skin, overexposure, see-through clothes, extra or missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, unnatural sitting posture, poor contact with the wall, floating, shadows inconsistent with light sources, incorrect perspective, unnecessary people or objects, text, logos, watermarks, or direct replication of composition or clothing from reference images.\

Ultra-realistic portrait of a beautiful Korean woman standing near the back of the classroom, a vintage 35mm film camera raised to her eye, looking through the viewfinder — photographing something outside the frame. One eye closed, one focused into the lens. Expression concentrated, quiet, self-contained. Camera (our camera) positioned to her side and slightly behind at a three-quarter angle, capturing her in profile.
Wearing a camel-colored vintage corduroy blazer over a soft white crew-neck tee, tucked into high-waisted dark brown straight-leg trousers. Dark brown leather belt, matching brown leather loafers. Thin wire-frame round glasses. Long dark brown hair pulled into a relaxed low bun with a tortoiseshell clip, a few strands loose at the temples. A well-worn canvas camera bag on the desk behind her.
The golden afternoon light is the subject and the setup simultaneously — she is photographing it. The light streams in from the classroom windows directly into her lens, creating a warm backlit flare around the camera body. Her camel blazer glows like aged amber in the golden hour. Dust motes float beautifully in the shaft of light she is aiming at.
35mm analog film grain, Kodak Portra 400 — camel corduroy and dark brown trousers rendered in deep, lush Portra earth tones. Hyper-realistic corduroy fabric texture, vintage camera metal and glass detail, lens flare. Shallow depth of field. Mood: the photographer inside the photograph, self-referential and quietly poetic, editorial with intellectual texture.\

title: 城市生活混合媒体拼贴
author: Hemayxn.ai

prompt_en:
Create a cinematic mixed-media fashion editorial collage

The composition should feel like a fragmented visual diary of a young man slowly disappearing into the rhythm of modern urban life.

Instead of a clean magazine layout, build the image like a layered wall of memories, screenshots, late-night photographs and torn printed posters assembled by hand over time.

The collage should contain multiple interconnected scenes of the same male character across one long sleepless city night:

rooftop solitude,

elevator mirror selfies,

empty subway platforms,

neon-lit convenience stores,

cigarette smoke drifting through alleyways,

blurry taxi reflections,

apartment-window loneliness,

headphones on during midnight walks,

and quiet moments of emotional exhaustion.

The same person should appear consistently throughout the collage but in different emotional states rather than different poses.

ART DIRECTION:

Blend:

luxury streetwear editorial photography,

analog film texture,

layered paper collage aesthetics,

distressed print graphics,

underground fashion magazines,

and modern urban melancholy.

Avoid: generic “cool guy” influencer aesthetics, symmetrical layouts, or overly polished AI perfection.

The composition should feel: messy in an intentional way.

Integrate:

torn paper edges,

tape marks,

handwritten notes,

distorted timestamps,

subway tickets,

blurred chat notifications,

weather widgets,

music-player overlays,

barcode fragments,

scratched textures,

scanned notebook pages,

and partially ripped typography.

The typography should feel fragmented and emotionally detached rather than motivational.

Examples: “2:17 AM” “offline.” “seen recently.” “somewhere between leaving and staying.” “low battery.” “city noise.”

No inspirational quotes.

WARDROBE:

Dark layered streetwear with realistic styling:

oversized hoodies,

washed leather jackets,

silver chains,

cargo pants,

worn sneakers,

heavy headphones,

slightly messy hair,

realistic fabric folds and texture.

The clothing should feel: expensive but lived-in.

LIGHTING:

Every section of the collage should use realistic urban nighttime lighting:

sodium-vapor streetlights,

convenience-store fluorescents,

elevator LEDs,

rainy reflections,

warm apartment lamps,

passing headlights,

rooftop city glow.

Use realistic low-light behavior:

soft sensor grain,

slight blur,

chromatic aberration,

imperfect exposure,

flash reflections,

realistic digital-camera texture.

COLOR PALETTE:

charcoal black, washed amber, cold teal, silver reflections, muted cream paper tones, faded neon and dark urban browns.

The final image should feel like: a visual archive of someone trying to stay emotionally visible in a city designed to make everyone disappear.\

Canvas: Portrait page, warm off-white paper texture, thin brown hand-drawn border around the whole page and around each of the 4 horizontal panels. Gentle beige shadows, pastel colors, small pink cherry blossom petals scattered throughout.

Main character: A chibi creator with short pink hair, large amber eyes, a round face, tiny body, and a simple loose blue outfit. The character appears exactly 5 times across the comic: curious beside a tablet in panel 1, worried while pressing a generate button in panel 2, panicking at a signpost in panel 3, collapsed face-down on a desk in panel 4, and as a small thumbnail in the generated-results UI in panel 2.

Panel 1: On the left, show a tilted tablet or monitor displaying the Anifusion interface with exactly 3 selectable menu items labeled in Japanese: 「画像」, 「ページ」, 「レイヤー」. The main preview area contains a large question mark. On the right, the chibi character looks at the screen with uncertainty. Add a speech bubble reading: 「新ツール『Anifusion』に挑戦！……で、画像・ページ・レイヤーってどれから触るの？」 Include a tiny sparkle near the character.

Panel 2: Show a close-up of the tool interface labeled 「生成結果」. It contains exactly 3 result cards: a blank dashed frame labeled 「フレーム欠損」, a cute pink-haired character image labeled 「服が違う」, and a strange green monster labeled 「意味不明」. Beneath them, show a credit meter with exactly 5 filled coin circles and 5 empty dotted circles, plus a large blue button labeled 「生成」 being clicked by the character. The main chibi character is seen from behind/right side, sweating. Add a speech bubble reading: 「あれ？なんか違う…」 and a small side note reading: 「容赦なく溶けていくクレジット。」

Panel 3: The chibi character stands in the center with spiral eyes, raised hands, sweat drops, and panic symbols above the head. On the left, a wooden sign arrow points left and reads 「NanobananaPro」 with a small banana drawing. On the right, a wooden sign points right and reads 「GPT Image 2 Low」 with tiny star decorations. Add a speech bubble reading: 「モデル変える？タイミングはいつ!? これ、完成する気がしないよ〜！」

Panel 4: A desk scene showing the exhausted chibi collapsed face-down in the center, only pink hair and blue outfit visible. On the left side of the desk, include exactly 3 snack/drink items: a pink mug with a flower, a small plate of potato chips, and an orange snack bag labeled 「ポテチ」. On the right, show a tablet or monitor with exactly 2 sticky notes: 「まずは小さく」 and 「1ページずつ！」. Also include a small potted plant and exactly 2 stacked notebooks, the top one labeled 「メモ」. Above the character, add a pale ghost-like sigh symbol. Add lesson text at upper left: 「教訓：分からないまま作ると、完成の前に『気力』と『クレジット』が尽きる。」 Add a speech bubble near the mug reading: 「明日はまず1ページに絞ろう…」

Visual style: Japanese kawaii diary manga, hand-painted watercolor, soft ink outlines, rounded forms, muted pastel palette, cozy handmade feel, slightly imperfect handwritten text, expressive chibi emotions, no harsh digital gradients.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 horizontal comic panels and the exact counted elements listed above. Keep all text legible and handwritten in Japanese where specified. Do not add extra panels, extra characters, logos, watermarks, or unrelated UI elements.\

Show exactly 5 prominent lily elements: 1 large foreground lily at bottom right, 1 partially visible foreground lily beneath it, 1 large soft-focus lily behind the right side of her head, 1 pale lily near the upper right edge, and 1 blurred lily shape in the lower foreground. A small flower-language information block sits beneath the headline with thin decorative vertical and horizontal line markers. A poetic body text block sits in the lower-left quadrant. Keep the subject centered-right and the flowers framing her, with dreamy depth of field.
